title: Reading long verbs
goal: Take a stacked verb apart from the root out, and build reciprocal, causative and passive stacks such as tanıştırıldım.

intro.text: Voices stack in a fixed order: reciprocal or reflexive, causative, passive. *tanı-* (know) → *tanış-* (meet) → *tanıştır-* (introduce) → *tanıştırıl-* (be introduced). Read a long verb from the root out and ask, at each step, who does what.

vocab.en: to reconcile, to get (people) to make up

exercises.question: *Ayşe'yle bir düğünde tanıştırıldım.* What happened?
options: Someone introduced me to Ayşe at a wedding.
I introduced Ayşe to someone at a wedding.

why.1: That would be the active *Ayşe'yi biriyle tanıştırdım*. The passive *-ıl* makes me the one introduced.
why.2: The wedding is just the place: *bir düğünde*.

exercises.explain: *tanı-ş-tır-ıl-dı-m*: reciprocal (meet), causative (someone makes us meet), passive (that someone isn't named), past, **I**.
Root, reciprocal *-ş*, causative *-tır*, passive *-ıl*, past *-dı*, *-m*. Harmony follows the a and ı of each step.

exercises.question: Which verb is built in the right order?

why.1: The passive can't come before the causative.
why.2: The passive can't come before the causative, and after *-ıl* the causative would not be *-tır* anyway.

exercises.explain: Causative first, passive second: *yap-tır-ıl-dı*, **it was had done**.

exercises.en: Come, let me introduce you to my mother.

accept: tırayım

reject.why: *Tanışayım* would be **let me meet her**. To introduce you, add the causative: *tanış-tır-ayım*.
The passive is **I was introduced**. Here I am the one introducing: *tanıştırayım*.

exercises.explain: *tanış-tır-ayım*: the causative, then the optative **let me**. *Annemle* gives the other person, with *-(y)lA*.

exercises.prompt: I was introduced to Mehmet at a wedding.
accept: Mehmet'le bir düğünde tanıştırıldım.
Mehmet ile bir düğünde tanıştırıldım.
Ben Mehmet'le bir düğünde tanıştırıldım.
Ben Mehmet ile bir düğünde tanıştırıldım.
(Ben) bir düğünde [Mehmet'le|Mehmet ile] tanıştırıldım.

reject.why: *Tanıştım* is **I met him**. **I was introduced** needs the causative and the passive: *tanıştırıldım*.
The person you are introduced to takes *-(y)lA*: *Mehmet'le*.

exercises.en: The matter was discussed at yesterday's meeting.

exercises.question: *İki kardeş barıştırılamadı.* Read it from the root out. What does it mean?
options: The two brothers couldn't be reconciled.
The two brothers couldn't make peace with each other.
The two brothers didn't reconcile anyone.

why.1: That would be *barışamadı*, without the causative: they themselves couldn't make up.
why.2: The passive *-ıl* makes the brothers the ones others tried to reconcile.

exercises.explain: *barış-tır-ıl-a-ma-dı*: someone tried to make them make up (*-tır*), the someone is hidden (*-ıl*), and it failed (*-a-ma*).

exercises.label: *tanıştırılmak*, past: I was introduced, you were introduced…

accept: tanıştırıldım
tanıştırıldın
tanıştırıldı
tanıştırıldık
tanıştırıldınız
tanıştırıldılar
tanıştırıldı

exercises.explain: The stack *tanıştırıl-* never changes; the past and the person go on the end: *tanıştırıl-dı-m*.

exercises.prompt: The children were dressed early for the wedding.
accept: Çocuklar erkenden düğün için giydirildi.
Düğün için çocuklar erkenden giydirildi.

exercises.en: The apprentice was introduced to his master.
